projects.name: Interactive SOAP explainer
projects.description: Interactive 3D walkthrough of the SOAP atomic descriptor: density → spherical harmonics → power spectrum → mu1nu1 compression, with real dscribe-computed data and standalone embeddable widgets.

projects.name: MatterVial
projects.description: Hybrid materials-informatics framework combining feature-based descriptors, graph neural networks, and symbolic regression for accuracy + interpretability. Published in npj Computational Materials (2026) — my first-author paper.

projects.name: VibroML
projects.description: Automated toolkit for high-throughput vibrational analysis and dynamic-instability remediation of crystalline materials using machine-learned potentials. arXiv preprint 2026; open code, support data and an 83k-structure Figshare dataset.

projects.name: ProtoCSP
projects.description: Crystal-structure prediction by prototype search and transmutation, co-developed with the VibroML pipeline. Open source (MIT); presented in the VibroML paper.

projects.name: MEIDNet
projects.description: Multimodal generative AI framework for inverse materials design, co-developed at MODL/UCLouvain with A. Babu, P. Vandergheynst, and G.-M. Rignanese. Published in npj Computational Materials (2026).

projects.name: modnet-pt
projects.description: PyTorch rewrite of MODNet with a scikit-learn API: fit(X, y) on plain DataFrames, no MODData. Full functional parity — featurization presets, FRR feature selection, joint learning, preset + genetic search, ensembles. Model-level parity confirmed on matbench_dielectric (MAE 0.347 vs 0.353 upstream).

projects.name: OpenClaw agent fleet
projects.description: Self-hosted OpenClaw gateway on Docker driving a Telegram-interfaced agent fleet that ships code, manages projects, and keeps this site updated.

projects.name: rogeriog.github.io
projects.description: This portfolio site — a static GitHub Pages site designed, built, and maintained by autonomous OpenClaw agents in direct collaboration with me.
